description: The page's banner landmark. On desktop it holds the brand, a labelled navigation landmark with the page links (the current page marked aria-current="page"), and the actions. Below lg, a menu button opens a modal dialog (Radix Dialog) holding the same links and the actions.

keyboard.action: Moves through the brand, links and actions in visual order.
Opens the menu sheet and moves focus into it.
Closes the menu sheet and returns focus to the menu button.
Cycles focus within the sheet (focus is trapped while it is open).

focus.notes: Focus is trapped only while the mobile sheet is open. Following any link inside the sheet closes it, and so does a pathname change.

announcements: The sheet is announced as a dialog named by its title ("Menu").
The active link is announced as "current page".
screenReader.notes: The desktop links and the sheet links share one label (labels.nav), and only one set is rendered visibly at a time; the other is display:none, so it is hidden from assistive tech too.

contrast.text: Links: muted-foreground (6.5:1 on cream), active and hover foreground.
contrast.ui: The bottom border is decorative. The bar background is 90% opaque, so text behind it never shows through at a contrast-affecting level.

motion.reducedMotion: The sheet slides in over 200ms; the slide is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

consumerResponsibilities: Pass pathname (usePathname() in Next.js) so the active link and sheet closing work.
Keep to at most four links; set exact on the home link.
Don't nest another banner landmark; render SiteHeader once, outside <main>.
